pages.title: Just in Case
pages.text: Craft an Idol of Retrieval and learn its lost-item recovery conditions.

pages.title: Just in Case
pages.text: Cedar logs and cooked food prepare the next expedition without forcing an intentional death to test the idol.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Do not die for the quest. Crafting introduces the recovery tool beforehand; recovering real lost items remains an optional use after an ordinary mishap.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Retrieve your lost items with Idol of Retrieval. The native progression identifies an item-recovery loop; do not create a quest requiring deliberate death.
